text: Welcome to Grandview Hotel! I'm Kelly, your hotel assistant. How may I assist you today?
Hi, Kelly. I need the food service.
May I have your room number, please?
Sure. What service can I assist you with today?
With the food service, you can assist me.
Okay! Let's see… what items would you like?
I would like, I would like to have two cheeseburger and one cold coffee.
Okay, two cheeseburger and one cold coffee. Is there any special instructions for the cold coffee, perhaps a milk preference?
Got it. Two cheeseburger and one cold coffee no special instructions. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
